$description: App experience density. Remapped under [data-experience=app] in generated web.css.

control.$description: sm == md on purpose: app has a touch-target floor (touchTarget.min, 44px), so no control *hit target* may sit below it. Web keeps a real 28/32/36 scale because a pointer has no minimum hit area. Do not 'restore' a smaller app sm — that reintroduces sub-44px tap targets. `visualSize` is the one legitimate sub-44px dimension in this group and the only exception to the floor: it is not a hit target, it is the affordance painted *inside* one (#1034), so it must stay strictly below `md`.

visualSize.$description: The affordance actually painted inside a control — the circle a capsule icon action draws — as opposed to the box that receives the tap. A control keeps its `control.md` hit target (44px) and draws this smaller circle inside it (#1034), so a row of secondary actions stops reading as a row of primary buttons. The inequality is the point: 36 < 44 on App, and a value that reached or passed the hit target would be the silent revert the design gate fails. Declared in both experiences because one class serves both — an App-only leaf would resolve to nothing at `:root`.

sessionsListMinHeight.$description: How much of the App Sessions surface the Session list keeps for itself, as a share of that surface. The surface is a column of chrome above the list and a status foot below it, and at a short viewport (a phone held in landscape, #1057) the chrome alone can be taller than the surface — the column it replaced measured 328px of chrome at 390px tall, which left the list wrapper at exactly 0px and every Session row unreachable. A share rather than a pixel floor: the surface is 390px on one phone and 932px on another, and a length tuned to either would be wrong on the other. The chrome yields first and scrolls inside what is left, so the list holds this floor without the surface overflowing. It is deliberately not binding at the canonical portrait viewports, where the list already measures ~68% of the surface — it is the crisis floor for a short one.

terminal.$description: The App work surface's own typography and inset — the counterpart of `experience.web.terminal`, so the same leaf names exist on both sides and neither resolves to nothing outside its own experience. The mockup's `.phone-term` draws `font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.7; padding: 14px 14px 96px`: a step smaller and a step looser than Web, because the App terminal is read at arm's length on a smaller surface. The 96px bottom is the App capsule's box plus safe area and is therefore measured (`--terminal-content-bottom-inset`), not frozen here — see the same note in `experience/web.json`.

lineHeight.$description: Converted, not transcribed — same unit difference as `experience.web.terminal.lineHeight`, same method. The mockup's `.phone-term` CSS `line-height: 1.7` multiplies the font size: 11.5px × 1.7 = a 19.55px line box. xterm multiplies the font's measured box instead, 1.30em = 14.95px at 11.5px. The number that reproduces the mockup's leading is therefore 19.55 ÷ 14.95 = 1.31; the mockup's raw `1.7` would draw a 25px row, 28% looser.

projectionMarginBottom.$description: Gap between an emerged projection and the capsule below it. Close enough to read as attached to it, far enough that the two surfaces do not merge.

projectionMaxHeight.$description: Ceiling for an emerged projection (#826 Q5). Lower than Web's: the App capsule sits closer to the bottom edge and its projection has less room above it for the same content.

projectionFontSize.$description: One step below the capsule's own scale. A Signal is the smallest identifying state, not the composer's text, so it must not arrive at the field's size.

projectionMarkWidth.$description: The change letter's column (M/A/D/?) in a compact listing. Fixed so the filenames beside it share a left edge.

dockTarget.$description: App dock targets: the workspace-navigation band declares touchTarget.compact (#730) instead of the 44px chrome floor, because it floats over the terminal rather than taking a row from it. control-md is 44px on app by design, so this cannot borrow it.
